item.description: Columbia Acting President Claire Shipman has said that DHS agents "misrepresented" that "they were police searching for a missing child."

item.title: Daily Horoscope for March 07, 2026
item.description: Connection can't blossom in a vacuum -- we must reach out to each other. While the luminous Sun conjoins chatty Mercury early, conversations could reveal truths we missed. Slow down and listen for nuance. At 6:27 am EST, Venus conjoins dreamy Neptune, blending tenderness with imagination as we reimagine what feels worthy and adjust promises to match. When we speak from our hearts, pressure eases. We'd also be wise to leave plenty of space for quiet reflection. Let softness guide choices that mat

item.title: What we’ve learned about the Mets in spring training
item.description: Top prospect Carson Benge is still the favorite to win the starting right field job

item.title: Pro- and anti-Khamenei protesters clash at Washington Square Park, multiple arrests made
item.description: Multiple people were arrested in a clash between pro-Iranian regime demonstrators, who erected a shrine to Iran's slain Ayatollah Khamenei, and anti-Khamenei protesters at Washington Square Park on Friday, cops said.

item.title: Boy, 15, shot in shoulder outside Brooklyn apartment building
item.description: The victim was shot outside an apartment building on Bay Parkway near Kings Highway in Bensonhurst around 7:30 p.m., according to police.

item.title: Timothée Chalamet says ‘no one cares’ about opera or ballet
item.description: Academy Award nominee Timothée Chalamet offended members of the opera and ballet communities by saying no one cares about those art forms nowadays.

item.title: Home decor giant Victoria Mackenzie Childs dies at 77
item.description: Artist Victoria Mackenzie-Childs is dead at 77. She spent 25 years living on a ferry after her popular Mackenzie-Childs brand went bankrupt in 2000.

item.title: Zuby Ejiofor powers No. 18 St. John’s past Seton Hall for at least a share of the Big East title
item.description: Rick Pitino's Red Storm would win the regular-season crown outright if Marquette defeats Connecticut on Saturday.
